column1: # Quarantine ledger for flaky-test skips, verified by scripts/check-quarantine-ledger.mjs.
# A .skip/.todo/.only marker may be added to an existing test only when a live row here
# covers it. One row per marker; remove the row and the marker together.
#   test    repo-relative test file, optionally "<path> > <full test name>"
#           (describe path joined with ' > ', as Vitest reports it)
#   repo    owner/name the row applies to (e.g. ashlrai/phantom)
#   lead    accountable owner (person or team handle)
#   expiry  YYYY-MM-DD (end of that UTC day) or ISO-8601 datetime with offset;
#           must be in the future and no more than 7 days out
# Non-quarantinable (Security R8): secret-shape, gitleaks, cargo-deny, ci-gate.
# Rows naming them, or skips inside files matching them, fail the gate.
